title: Editor Structure Large Document Navigation Performance Checklist

items.label: Capture Project Control, terminology, Editor, Backend, and Core boundary context before implementation.
items.evidenceTarget: Project Control entrypoint, Work path, owner repository, terminology, Editor AGENTS.md, and the bounded Structure panel navigation/performance target are reviewed before implementation.
items.verificationNote: Identified Work path flowdoc-product-development-resumption > flowdoc-core-backend-editor-readiness-pass-8h, owner repository repo-editor with bounded repo-backend/repo-core live smoke references, phase-flowdoc-core-backend-editor-readiness-pass-editor-structure-large-document-navigation-performance, checklist-flowdoc-core-backend-editor-readiness-pass-editor-structure-large-document-navigation-performance, and evidence target evidence-editor-structure-large-document-navigation-performance-2026-08-31 before edits.

items.label: Write failing Editor and Project Control tests before accepting the Structure panel safeguards.
items.evidenceTarget: Focused Editor tests fail before large Structure lists are windowed, before group collapse/forced-open behavior exists, before the live smoke retains Structure navigation metadata, and before Project Control knows this phase/evidence.
items.verificationNote: RED evidence included outlineScannability failures for missing data-outline-windowed, data-outline-toggle-target, and data-outline-forced-open; editorBrowserLiveBackendSmokeEvidence failure before initialStructureNavigation existed; a source guard failure for the previous cursor = index + 1 descendant scan; and project-roadmap-work-queue failure before this Project Control phase/evidence was registered.

items.label: Bound rendered Structure rows for large Outline lists while keeping the selected item visible.
items.evidenceTarget: OutlinePanel emits data-outline-windowed, before/after window gap markers, selected item index, and a rendered item count smaller than the full list for large structures.
items.verificationNote: OutlinePanel now creates a navigation model that windows visible item rows around selectedNodeId once the visible item count exceeds the bounded threshold, emits hidden-count markers, and keeps the selected row rendered and selected.

items.label: Add collapse/expand affordances without hiding the active selected descendant.
items.evidenceTarget: Parent Outline rows with descendants expose a toggle, collapsed descendants are summarized, and a collapsed selected ancestor path is forced open.
items.verificationNote: OutlinePanel exposes data-outline-toggle-target and data-outline-toggle-state on rows with children, emits data-outline-collapsed-summary for hidden descendants, and emits data-outline-forced-open when a collapsed parent contains the selected descendant.

items.label: Preserve full Structure rows for the small active live Backend document.
items.evidenceTarget: Retained live Backend browser smoke records initial and mutated Structure navigation metadata proving the small active document is not windowed and keeps all rows rendered.
items.verificationNote: The retained smoke records initialStructureNavigation itemCount/renderedItemCount 7 and mutatedStructureNavigation itemCount/renderedItemCount 9, with windowed false, toggleCount 2, hiddenMarkerCount 0, and forcedOpenCount 0.

items.label: Keep the slice navigation-only and preserve authoring/mutation boundaries.
items.evidenceTarget: The change does not enable direct typing, contenteditable, WYSIWYG, exact table/cell authoring, new Backend mutation sources, Core truth, Backend truth, Editor truth, broad readiness, or map truth.
items.verificationNote: No Core or Backend files changed. The changed Editor files are OutlinePanel, editor.css, Outline scannability tests, and retained live smoke evidence collection. Existing text-block textarea and add-node mutation boundaries remain unchanged.

items.label: Run worktree and merged-main Editor/Project Control gates and record cleanup state honestly.
items.evidenceTarget: Editor worktree and merged main pass focused tests, full check, and no-write live Backend browser smoke; Project Control record gates pass; cleanup state is recorded.
items.verificationNote: Editor worktree passed focused Vitest, npm run evidence:editor-browser-live-backend-smoke, npm run check with 102 test files and 367 tests plus build, and FLOWDOC_EVIDENCE_WRITE=0 npm run evidence:editor-browser-live-backend-smoke. Merged Editor main passed npm run check with 102 test files and 367 tests plus build, then FLOWDOC_EVIDENCE_WRITE=0 npm run evidence:editor-browser-live-backend-smoke. Branch fd-ed-struct-navperf-0831 was deleted after fast-forward merge, and the residual .worktrees/fd-ed-struct-navperf-0831 folder was removed after Git deregistered it and the absolute cleanup target was verified. Project Control worktree and merged main passed npm run check, including check:data, type-check, 59 Vitest files with 330 tests, build, and 6 Playwright e2e tests.
